question: How many days after delivery can a customer return an eligible item?
expected_answer: An eligible item may be returned within 30 days of delivery.

question: Which items are not eligible for return?
expected_answer: Final-sale items, personalized items, and opened digital-download codes are not eligible, except where applicable law requires otherwise.

question: How long does a refund take after the returned item is inspected?
expected_answer: The refund is initiated within 5 business days after inspection; the bank may take additional time to post it.

question: What should a customer do if an item arrives damaged?
expected_answer: Report the damage within 48 hours of delivery and include the order number and clear photos of the packaging and item.

question: When is standard domestic shipping usually delivered?
expected_answer: Usually within 3–5 business days after dispatch.

question: Does a tracking number mean the parcel has already moved?
expected_answer: No. Tracking may take up to 24 hours after dispatch to show its first carrier scan.

question: What happens if the delivery address is wrong after dispatch?
expected_answer: Contact support immediately; an address change is not guaranteed after dispatch.

question: How can a customer contact support?
expected_answer: Email support@example.test and include the order number when the request concerns an order.

question: What information should a customer provide when reporting a billing issue?
expected_answer: The order number, a description of the discrepancy, and the transaction date; never send a full payment-card number.

question: Which payment methods are supported in this sample policy?
expected_answer: Credit/debit cards and the listed local wallet option are supported; options shown at checkout are authoritative.

question: Can a customer share a one-time password with support?
expected_answer: No. Support will never ask for a password, one-time password, or full card number.

question: What should a customer do if they suspect unauthorized account access?
expected_answer: Change the password from the official account page and contact support promptly.

question: What is the warranty period for eligible hardware accessories?
expected_answer: Eligible hardware accessories have a 12-month limited warranty from delivery, subject to the stated exclusions.

question: Does the warranty cover accidental liquid damage?
expected_answer: No. Accidental liquid damage and unauthorized modifications are excluded.

question: How long should a customer wait before contacting support about a missing parcel?
expected_answer: Contact support if tracking has not updated for 5 business days or the estimated delivery date has passed by 2 business days.
